text:
Mina Park: Quick thread to lock the telemetry plan for the Datadog/OTel demo next Wednesday. Key constraints: never send raw prompts, keep span tag cardinality low, and include a deterministic but salted request hash.

Ethan Wu: Agree. Minimal attribute set: redwood.model, redwood.version, redwood.req_hash, redwood.latency_ms, redwood.seq_bucket, redwood.gpu_shard. No logits, no prompt.

Priya Nair: For seq_bucket use labels small/medium/large (<128/128-512/>512). We should also add a 1% default probabilistic sampler and 100% on-error capture for status>=500.

Marco Diaz: Example collector snippet to share with SIs (will publish as plain text in the partner repo):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: prompt
        action: delete
      - key: request_id
        action: hash
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 1
exporters:
  datadog:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes, probabilistic_sampler]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Mina Park: Good. Marketing/legal want a one-liner for the marketplace tile: "Telemetry exports aggregated runtime metrics and hashed identifiers only; user inputs are redacted." Can legal confirm?

Ethan Wu: Legal sign-off pending but likely OK. Also note: salt gpu_shard per-customer to avoid cross-tenant correlation. Document salt rotation policy.

deploy-bot: Demo reserved 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC. Upload path: /shared/marketplace/demo-assets/4130000000 by 2026-04-06.

Priya Nair: Action items: (1) Priya -> finalize sampler + seq_bucket transform (Mon) (2) Marco -> publish collector snippet and partner README (Tue) (3) Mina -> one-liner to legal and marketing (ASAP).
